definitions.explanation: Abstract beauty, especially as an aesthetic ideal or quality to be appreciated in art, nature, or design. Used as a one-character noun in formal and literary writing, and as a productive suffix in many compounds.

examples.japanese: {美|び}を{追求|ついきゅう}する。
{自然|しぜん}の{美|び}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by the beauty of nature.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{庭園|ていえん}には{季節|きせつ}ごとに{違|ちが}う{美|び}がある。
examples.english: A Japanese garden has a different kind of beauty in each season.

notes:
As a standalone noun, {美|び} is formal and abstract — closer to English "beauty" as a concept than to "a beautiful thing." In everyday speech, {美|うつく}しさ is more common for "beauty" of a specific object or scene.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {美|び}{術|じゅつ}: art (fine art)
- {美人|びじん}: a beautiful woman
- {美容|びよう}: cosmetic care; beauty (industry)
- {美味|びみ}しい: delicious (the more common form is おいしい)
- {美意識|びいしき}: aesthetic sense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美|うつく}しさ: beauty (of something specific) — concrete, everyday
- {美|うつく}しい: beautiful (adjective)
